      Gets a live, composable entity query for this world.
      Returns:
      An unfiltered entity query; add filters via EntityQuery.ofType(java.lang.String) and EntityQuery.within(nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.BlockPos, nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.BlockPos).

    • blockAt

      public BlockRef blockAt(BlockPos position)
      Gets a live reference to the block at a position.

      The reference stores only the address; every read through it re-queries the server.

      Parameters:
      position - The block position.
      Returns:
      A live block reference.

    • setBlockAt

      public void setBlockAt(BlockPos position, BlockSpec spec)
      Sets the block at a position from a block spec, applying type and state properties atomically.

      Placement applies a physics update: attachable or gravity-affected blocks (levers, torches, sand) need a valid supporting block in place first, or they break or fall immediately.

      Parameters:
      position - The block position.
      spec - The block spec, e.g. BlockSpec.parse("minecraft:lever[face=floor,powered=true]").
